_comment: Red-flag rules for score.py. PLACEHOLDER weights by Peter, to be replaced by Mia's rules (Gold Coast criteria + ReferALS). Edit numbers and text here, no code changes needed.

umn_signs.why: Upper motor neuron signs (brisk reflexes, Hoffmann, Babinski, spasticity)

sensory_loss.why: Sensory loss points to a nerve or root problem instead

significant_pain.why: Pain is the main problem (less typical of ALS)

treatment_failure.why: No response to treatment for the presumed cause

conduction_block.why: Motor conduction block points to MMN, a treatable mimic

umn_and_lmn.why: Upper and lower motor neuron signs together (Gold Coast)

lmn_two_regions.why: Lower motor neuron signs in 2 or more body regions (Gold Coast)

motor_spread.why: Motor problems in 2 or more body regions

gold_coast_rule: Progression AND (UMN + LMN signs, OR LMN signs in 2+ regions) AND no conduction block -> urgent, whatever the score.

recommendations.urgent: Urgent referral to neurology (ALS / motor neuron disease clinic). Request EMG if not already done. Do not wait for further treatment trials.
recommendations.monitor: Possible early pattern. Re-examine in 4 to 6 weeks and refer to neurology if weakness spreads, wasting appears, or treatment does not help.
recommendations.low: No ALS red-flag pattern in these notes.
